```{r}

endpoint <- sub("^https?://", "", Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))


idealista <- s3read_using(
  FUN    = readr::read_csv,
  object = "idealista/202606_residential_metrics_idealistadata_v2.csv",
  bucket = "mperier",
  opts   = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT")),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = "?", LOCATIONID = readr::col_character())
)

objs <- get_bucket_df(
  bucket   = "mperier",
  prefix   = "turismo/exp_viv_turistica_tabla5_",
  base_url = endpoint,
  region   = "",
  max      = Inf
)

fichiers <- grep("exp_viv_turistica_tabla5_[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}\\.xlsx$",
                 objs$Key, value = TRUE)
fichiers 


# Table de correspondance : nom en minuscules -> nom de référence
noms_ref <- c(
  "CODIGO"                        = "CUDIS",
  "codigo"                        = "CUDIS",
  "cudis"                         = "CUDIS",
  "nivel"                         = "Nivel",
  "nota1"                         = "NOTA1",
  "vivienda turistica"            = "vivienda turistica",
  "unidad1"                       = "unidad1",
  "nota2"                         = "nota2",
  "plazas"                        = "plazas",
  "unidad2"                       = "unidad2",
  "nota3"                         = "nota3",
  "plazas por vivienda turistica" = "plazas por vivienda turistica",
  "plaza por vivienda turistica"  = "plazas por vivienda turistica",
  "unidad3"                       = "unidad3",
  "nota4"                         = "nota4",
  "porcentaje vivienda turistica" = "Porcentaje vivienda turistica",
  "unidad4"                       = "UNIDAD4",
  "periodo"                       = "PERIODO",
  "prov"                          = "PROV",
  "prov_literal"                  = "PROV_LITERAL",
  "mun"                           = "MUN",
  "mun_literal"                   = "MUN_LITERAL"
)

harmoniser <- function(df) {
  nouveaux <- unname(noms_ref[tolower(names(df))])
  # si un nom est inconnu, on garde l'original plutôt que de produire un NA
  names(df) <- ifelse(is.na(nouveaux), names(df), nouveaux)
  df
}


cols <- c("CUDIS", "Nivel", "vivienda turistica", "plazas",
          "plazas por vivienda turistica", "Porcentaje vivienda turistica",
          "PERIODO", "PROV", "PROV_LITERAL", "MUN", "MUN_LITERAL")

t_distrito <- map_dfr(fichiers, function(f) {
  s3read_using(
    FUN    = readxl::read_xlsx,
    sheet  = 2,
    object = f,
    bucket = "mperier",
    opts   = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
  ) |>
    harmoniser() |>
    dplyr::select(all_of(cols)) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character),
           fichier = basename(f))
}) %>% arrange(CUDIS, PERIODO) %>%
  relocate(PERIODO, .after = CUDIS)
```

Joining districts with their geographical borders. We know the polygone for each census tract so we reconstruct distritos geography from that.

```{r frontières géo}
base <- "turismo/secciones2026_geo/SECC_CE_20260101"   # sans extension
dir.create("shp_tmp", showWarnings = FALSE)


for (ext in c("shp", "dbf", "shx", "prj", "CPG")) {
  dest <- file.path("shp_tmp", paste0("SECC_CE_20260101.", ext))
  
  tryCatch(
    s3read_using(
      FUN    = function(f, dest) file.copy(f, dest, overwrite = TRUE),
      dest   = dest,
      object = paste0(base, ".", ext),
      bucket = "mperier",
      opts   = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
    ),
    error = function(e) message("Échec pour .", ext, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
}

list.files("shp_tmp")


secc <- st_read("shp_tmp/SECC_CE_20260101.shp")
names(secc)   

# 1. Réparer les géométries invalides avant toute fusion
secc <- st_make_valid(secc)

# 3. Dissoudre : regrouper par distrito
distritos <- secc |>
  group_by(CUDIS) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")

# 4. Vérifications 
nrow(distritos) # Il en manque 8 : "4316101" "3601302" "3602503" "3208902" "2523403" "2301803" "0814102" "0407002" 
# pour les voir anti_join(t_distrito, st_drop_geometry(distritos),by = c("CUDIS" = "CUDIS"))
plot(st_geometry(distritos))
all(st_is_valid(distritos))

sf_distritos <- t_distrito %>% left_join(distritos, by = "CUDIS")
rm(distritos)
```

## Adapting idealista data to turismo data

Idealista data comes in seccXtrimestre whilst tourism data is seccXsemestre and districtXsemestre

We transform idealista trismestre dates to semestre as such : march and decembre =\> february and juin and septembre =\> august

```{r}

id <- idealista |>
  rename(CUSEC = LOCATIONID) %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(PERIOD), year = year(PERIOD),
    # mois du tourisme auquel on rattache chaque trimestre
    PERIODO = case_when(
      month == 12 ~ sprintf("%dM02", year + 1),   # déc N -> fév N+1
      month == 3  ~ sprintf("%dM02", year),       # mars N -> fév N
      month %in% c(6, 9) ~ sprintf("%dM08", year),       # sept N -> août N
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


pmoy <- function(prix, n) {
  if (all(is.na(prix))) return(NA_real_)
  if (sum(n, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) weighted.mean(prix, n, na.rm = TRUE)
  else mean(prix, na.rm = TRUE)
}

agreger <- function(df) {
  df |>
    group_by(CUSEC, PERIODO) |>
    summarise(
      prix_sale = pmoy(UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL, STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL),   # calculés AVANT les moyennes de n
      prix_rent = pmoy(UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL, STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL),
      n_sale    = mean(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rent    = mean(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

id_secc_sem <- id |>
  filter(!is.na(PERIODO)) |>
  agreger()

# Mai 2025 et mai 2026 (moyenne de mars et juin) <- id_secc_sem |>
 may <- id %>% filter(month %in% c(3, 6), year %in% c(2025, 2026)) |>
  mutate(PERIODO = sprintf("%dM05", year)) |>
  agreger()

 id_secc_sem <- bind_rows(id_secc_sem, may)
```

```{r seccion_sem}

periodes_exclues <- c("2025M02", "2025M08", "2026M02", "2026M08")

seccion_sem <- full_join(
  id_secc_sem |> filter(!PERIODO %in% periodes_exclues),
  t_seccion    |> filter(!PERIODO %in% periodes_exclues),
  by = c("CUSEC", "PERIODO"),
  suffix = c("_id", "_tur")
) %>% filter(!is.na(`vivienda turistica`)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), NA)))

# /!\ certaines sections censales ne sont aps renseignées dans les données de tourisme (alors qu'elles sont dans idealista) -> elles sont environ 1000 
# on décide de les supprimer car pour ne pas avoir de décalage dans les analyses 

```

```{r distrito_sem}
# Idealista grouped by district 

id_dis <- idealista |>
  rename(CUSEC = LOCATIONID) |>
  mutate(
    PERIOD = as.Date(PERIOD),
    CUSEC  = str_pad(as.character(CUSEC), 10, pad = "0"),
    CUDIS  = substr(CUSEC, 1, 7)          # 2 prov + 3 commune + 2 distrito
  ) |>
  group_by(CUDIS, PERIOD) |>
  summarise(
    # les prix d'abord : ils utilisent les stocks d'origine comme poids
    UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL = pmoy(UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL, STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL),
    UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL = pmoy(UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL, STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL),
    # puis les stocks, sommés (NA si aucune section n'a de valeur)
    STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL = if (all(is.na(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL))) NA_real_
    else sum(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
    STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL = if (all(is.na(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL))) NA_real_
    else sum(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



id2 <- id_dis |>
  mutate(
    month = month(PERIOD), year = year(PERIOD),
    PERIODO = case_when(
      month == 12 ~ sprintf("%dM02", year + 1),   # déc N -> fév N+1
      month == 3  ~ sprintf("%dM02", year),       # mars N -> fév N
      month %in% c(6, 9) ~ sprintf("%dM08", year),# juin/sept N -> août N
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

agreger <- function(df) {
  df |>
    group_by(CUDIS, PERIODO) |>
    summarise(
      prix_sale = pmoy(UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL, STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL),
      prix_rent = pmoy(UNITPRICE_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL, STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL),
      n_sale = if (all(is.na(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL))) NA_real_
      else mean(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_SALE_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rent = if (all(is.na(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL))) NA_real_
      else mean(STOCK_RESIDENTIAL_RENT_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

id_dis_sem <- id2 |>
  filter(!is.na(PERIODO)) |>
  agreger()

# Mai 2025 et mai 2026 (moyenne de mars et juin)
may <- id2 |>
  filter(month %in% c(3, 6), year %in% c(2025, 2026)) |>
  mutate(PERIODO = sprintf("%dM05", year)) |>
  agreger()

id_dis_sem <- bind_rows(id_dis_sem, may)
```

```{r dis_sem}

periodes_exclues <- c("2025M02", "2025M08", "2026M02", "2026M08")

distrito_sem <- full_join(
  id_dis_sem   |> filter(!PERIODO %in% periodes_exclues),
  t_distrito  |> filter(!PERIODO %in% periodes_exclues),
  by = c("CUDIS", "PERIODO"),
  suffix = c("_id", "_tur")
) |>
  filter(!is.na(`vivienda turistica`)) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), NA)))
```
